scope: Scalar fundamental linear-frequency propagation and separate Gaussian receiver; no image, clinical calibration, THI, Doppler or spatial aperture

units.attenuationSlope: dB/(cm MHz) for amplitude using 20 log10
units.spectrum: Relative Fourier amplitude (amplitude·us), arbitrary scale; integral over MHz yields relative amplitude
units.band: full width at half amplitude, -6.020599913279624 dB; not half power
units.powerSpectrum: Squared Fourier amplitude, not an absolute calibrated power density; frequency moments reported separately
units.noisePsd: Unit white analytic input PSD before the electronic receiver filter; arbitrary power/MHz

source.receiverSigmaDefinition: 1/sigmaR^2 = 1/sigmaOut^2 - 1/sigmaEcho^2; sigmaOut=c/(4*pi*0.26). Chosen generic benchmark, not measured calibration.

acceptance.unit: Numerical contracts on this synthetic scalar case; not fidelity tolerances or clinical acceptance
acceptance.dcStressInverseQuadratureBound: Composite trapezoid: F*df^2/12 * [1/v + 2*|omega|/(sqrt(v)*sqrt(e)) + omega^2] / sqrt(2*pi*v); added to omitted amplitude mass fraction for this stress only.
acceptance.receiverNoiseIndependentReference: Gaussian truncated PSD with variance vR/2 and peak1; without receiver, integralF, meanF/2, varianceF^2/12. Trapezoid uniform-PSD variance has the known discretization term df^2/6.

negativeControls: fixed attenuation incorrectly treated as frequency slope
receiver-noise passed through source and patient
rational downshift with tied fractional bandwidth used as fixed-receiver propagation
receiver-noise passed through the source pulse alone
assumptions: Non-dispersive equal sound speed in every layer; no interfaces, scattering spectra, focusing, gain, compression or log display.
S0 is an unattenuated fundamental echo spectrum; it is not silently reused as a physical one-way transmit spectrum.
Positive support truncation is explicit. Whole-axis Gaussian widths and moments are never equated to truncated moments without a reported error bound.
No reciprocal clinical assumption for arbitrary paths: passes=2 means this declared reciprocal scalar path only.
No temporal noise realization: noise control is receiver-shaped spectral density of unit white analytic input introduced after propagation.
S0 is the effective unfiltered pulse-echo spectrum; R is a separate electronic receiving filter, not a second copy of acoustic receive directivity.
Time is relative to propagation delay; the transform is a positive-frequency complex analytic impulse before demodulation, not a real Hermitian reconstruction or baseband IQ.

revision.reason: Preserved run01 fails two predeclared quadrature-resolution checks; refine frequency step only. Same cases, tolerances, support and FFT limits. No changed production model.
